products.name: Completion Fluids and Additives
products.description: Manufactures and markets clear brine fluids (CBFs), including calcium chloride, calcium bromide, zinc bromide, zinc calcium bromide, sodium bromide, and custom blends, as well as associated additives and services for oil and gas well drilling, completion, and workover operations. Delivered through physical manufacturing, blending, and on-site service teams.

products.name: Calcium Chloride Products
products.description: Produces and sells liquid and dry calcium chloride for use in water treatment, industrial, cement, food processing, road maintenance, ice melt, agricultural, and consumer products markets. Manufactured at company-owned facilities in the US and Finland and distributed globally.

products.name: Zinc Bromide Battery Electrolyte
products.description: Manufactures and sells ultra-pure zinc bromide and zinc bromide/zinc chloride blends (TETRA PureFlow and PureFlow Plus) as battery electrolyte for long-duration energy storage, primarily for battery technology companies. Produced using proprietary chemical processes at dedicated facilities.

products.name: Industrial Bromide and Biocide Products
products.description: Manufactures and sells sodium bromide and other bromide-based chemicals for industrial water treatment, primarily as a biocide in recirculated cooling tower waters and other applications. Produced at company facilities and distributed to industrial customers.

products.name: Water Management Services for Oil and Gas
products.description: Provides comprehensive water management services for onshore oil and gas operators, including water analysis, treatment, recycling, blending, distribution, storage, transfer, and environmental risk mitigation. Delivered via patented equipment, automation, and in-person service teams.

products.name: Produced Water Desalination and Mineral Extraction
products.description: Offers TETRA Oasis Total Desalination Solution (TDS), a patented end-to-end water treatment and desalination technology for beneficial re-use and mineral extraction from oil and gas produced water. Delivered through engineered systems and commercial plant installations.

products.name: Frac Flowback and Production Well Testing Services
products.description: Provides frac flowback, early production facilities, production well testing, sand management, and well flow management services for oil and gas wells, using specialized equipment and qualified personnel. Services are delivered on-site in major oil and gas producing regions.

products.name: Ecommerce Platform (BigCommerce)
products.description: A flexible, enterprise-grade SaaS ecommerce platform that enables businesses to operate online storefronts, manage catalogs and orders, and integrate with third-party systems. Delivered digitally via a multi-tenant, API-first architecture supporting both traditional and headless deployments.

products.name: Product Data Management and Syndication (Feedonomics)
products.description: A digital platform that structures, optimizes, and distributes product data across marketplaces, advertising channels, search engines, and social platforms, supporting order synchronization and workflow automation for merchants.

products.name: Visual Site Building Platform (Makeswift)
products.description: A digital, visual site-building platform that enables teams to create and manage digital experiences, accelerating page creation, campaign launches, and content updates through an intuitive interface.

products.name: Aviation Aftermarket Parts Distribution
products.description: Distribution of aftermarket parts for commercial, business, and general aviation operators, utilizing global distribution centers to ensure timely delivery to a diversified client base. This involves physical inventory management and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Aviation Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) Services
products.description: Provision of maintenance, repair, and overhaul services for aircraft components and engine accessories, performed at certified repair facilities by certified technicians to ensure regulatory compliance and rapid turnaround.

products.name: Aviation Supply Chain Management Services
products.description: Management of supply chain operations for aviation clients, including procurement, inventory management, and logistics to support aircraft fleet operations and ensure parts availability.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provides deposit products (checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit) and a wide range of loans (corporate, equipment, inventory, accounts receivable, acquisition, interim construction) to business customers, delivered through physical branches and online platforms. Includes commercial leases.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Offers traditional deposit products (checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit), consumer loans (home equity lines, home improvement loans, mortgages, overdraft, other consumer loans), and related services (safe deposit, online/mobile banking, ATM access) to individuals, delivered via branches, ATMs, and digital channels.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Delivers digital and in-person solutions to businesses for cash flow optimization, liquidity management, payroll, bill payment, and financial reporting, primarily through the Frost Connect digital platform and related tools.

products.name: Merchant Services
products.description: Provides integrated point-of-sale systems and business debit/credit cards to enable businesses to process transactions efficiently and securely at the point of sale.

products.name: Correspondent Banking Services
products.description: Offers check clearing, funds transfer, fixed income security services, and securities custody/clearance to other financial institutions, primarily banks, acting as their correspondent bank.

products.name: Capital Markets Services
products.description: Provides institutional clients with fixed-income sales and trading, new issue underwriting, money market trading, advisory services, and securities safekeeping/clearance, including specialized services for government and non-profit entities.

products.name: Global Trade and International Banking Services
products.description: Supports businesses engaged in international trade and customers dealing with Mexico by offering foreign exchange, trade finance (letters of credit, guarantees, collections), cross-border transaction facilitation, and international deposit/loan services (primarily in U.S. dollars).

products.name: Trust and Investment Management Services
products.description: Provides trust administration, estate administration, investment management, agency, and custodial services for individuals, corporations, employee benefit plans, and charitable foundations, managing and safeguarding client assets.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Offers a broad range of insurance products and services to businesses and individuals, including property and casualty, employee benefits, life, disability, long-term care, auto, valuables, and real estate insurance, primarily through agency arrangements.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides securities brokerage services for the purchase and sale of all types of securities to individuals and institutions, acting as a fully disclosed introducing broker-dealer without holding customer accounts or assets.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Delivers investment advisory and portfolio management services to mutual funds, institutions, and individuals, through registered investment advisor subsidiaries.

products.name: Enterprise Talent Management Services
products.description: Provides temporary staffing, outcome-based and permanent placement services focused on light industrial, contact center, and office/clerical roles in North America, as well as global workforce talent solutions including MSP, RPO, and PPO. Delivery involves recruiting, screening, and managing talent, often using proprietary technology platforms and managed service models.

products.name: Science, Engineering & Technology Talent Solutions
products.description: Offers highly specialized temporary staffing, outcome-based, and permanent placement services for science, clinical research, engineering, technology, and telecommunications roles, primarily in North America. Services are delivered through specialized recruiting and placement, leveraging industry expertise and brands such as MRP, Softworld, NextGen, and GTA.

products.name: Education Staffing and Therapy Services
products.description: Delivers temporary staffing, permanent placement, and executive search services for education and therapy professionals to Pre-K-12 school districts and education organizations across the U.S. Delivery includes recruiting, screening, and placing teachers and therapists, often through specialized brands.

products.name: Wireless Power Network (WPN) Platform
products.description: An end-to-end wireless power platform combining transmitter systems, receiver integrated circuits, antenna designs, and supporting software to deliver at-a-distance RF-based power and data to battery-free IoT devices. The platform is manufactured using advanced semiconductor chipsets and is deployed in commercial and industrial environments.

products.name: PowerBridge Transmitter Systems
products.description: Commercially manufactured RF-based transmitter systems designed to deliver wireless power at a distance to multiple receiver-enabled IoT devices. These systems are deployed as stand-alone units or integrated into third-party devices and networking infrastructure in enterprise, retail, logistics, healthcare, and industrial settings.

products.name: Wireless Power Receiver Integrated Circuits (ICs)
products.description: Semiconductor receiver ICs designed to be embedded in low-power, battery-free IoT devices, enabling them to receive RF-based wireless power for continuous operation without wired connections or battery replacement. These ICs are manufactured using fabless semiconductor processes and support a range of device applications.

products.name: Battery-Free IoT Device Solutions (Tags, Sensors, ESLs)
products.description: A suite of battery-free IoT device solutions, including asset tracking tags, environmental sensors, and electronic shelf labels (ESLs), all powered by wireless power technology. These devices are manufactured for deployment in retail, logistics, healthcare, and industrial environments for monitoring, tracking, and sensing applications.

products.name: e-Compass Cloud-Based Software Platform
products.description: A cloud-based software platform that enables monitoring and management of wireless power-enabled IoT devices, providing device data collection, deployment management, and business intelligence. Delivered digitally and integrated with hardware deployments for end-to-end solutions.

products.name: Proof-of-Concept Wireless Power Deployment Kits
products.description: Limited deployment kits consisting of transmitter and receiver components and associated software, provided to customers for proof-of-concept trials and early-stage testing of wireless power technology in specific application environments. These kits are manufactured as scalable building blocks for customer adaptation.

products.name: New Home Construction and Sales
products.description: Designs, builds, and sells single-family homes, townhomes, and condominiums across multiple U.S. markets, focusing on energy efficiency, quality construction, and tailored floorplans. Homes are constructed using in-person labor, physical materials, and are delivered through developed communities.

products.name: Active Adult (55+) Communities (Gatherings®)
products.description: Develops and sells homes in age-restricted, lower-maintenance communities for adults 55 and older, including condominiums, villas, duets, and single-family homes, with amenities and designs tailored to active adult lifestyles. Delivered through physical construction and community development.

products.name: Home Personalization and Design Services
products.description: Provides homebuyers with curated design packages, flexible floorplan options (Choice Plans®), and design studio consultations to personalize interior finishes and layouts. Delivered through in-person and digital consultations as part of the home purchase process.

products.name: Home Warranty and Customer Care Services
products.description: Offers post-sale warranty coverage for workmanship, materials, and structural elements, as well as ongoing customer care and support for homeowners. Delivered through in-person and remote service teams and a structured warranty program.

products.name: Solar-Ready and Solar-Included Homes
products.description: Builds homes with infrastructure for solar energy installation (solar-ready) and, in some communities, includes fully installed solar energy systems. Delivered through physical construction and integration of energy-efficient technologies.

products.name: Title and Home Insurance Services (Charity Title Agency and Charity Home Insurance Agency)
products.description: Provides title and home insurance services to homebuyers, with all net profits donated to the Beazer Charity Foundation. Delivered through wholly-owned agencies as part of the home purchase process.

products.name: Residential Rental Properties
products.description: Ownership, acquisition, development, renovation, and leasing of institutional-quality residential properties, including apartments, townhouses, duplexes, and build-to-rent communities, primarily located on single, contiguous parcels with amenities and onsite management. Properties are physically constructed, managed, and maintained for rental income.

products.name: Scattered Single-Family Home Rentals
products.description: Ownership, management, renovation, and leasing of scattered single-family homes, which are detached homes located across various markets, typically without onsite property management. These homes are physically acquired, renovated, and rented to tenants for income.

products.name: Preferred Equity and Loan Investments in Residential Real Estate
products.description: Provision of preferred equity and loan capital to third-party owners and developers of residential properties, earning income through interest or preferred returns and sometimes conversion to ownership. These are financial investments rather than direct property operations.

products.name: DST (Delaware Statutory Trust) Program for Individual Investors
products.description: Sponsorship and management of DST investment programs, allowing individual investors to acquire interests in specific residential properties, with Bluerock Homes retaining a management or ownership stake. This involves structuring, syndicating, and managing real estate investments for external investors.

products.name: Digital Engineering and Software Development Services
products.description: Comprehensive software engineering and product development services, including requirements analysis, platform selection, customization, migration, implementation, integration, testing, deployment, support, and maintenance, delivered by multidisciplinary teams using agile methodologies and proprietary tools.

products.name: Cloud Transformation and Migration Services
products.description: Consulting, implementation, and management of cloud technology solutions, including cloud strategy, migration, modernization, and customized cloud platforms, leveraging infrastructure expertise to enable clients' digital transformation and agility.

products.name: Data, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence Solutions
products.description: End-to-end data engineering, analytics, business intelligence, and AI services, including data platform modernization, governance, AI strategy, and implementation of AI-enabled business solutions using proprietary frameworks and accelerators.

products.name: Customer and Employee Experience Design Services
products.description: Human-centered design and engineering of digital and physical experiences, including customer journey mapping, product and service design, and employee experience transformation, delivered through integrated strategy, design, and technology teams.

products.name: Marketing and Digital Commerce Solutions
products.description: Integrated marketing, commerce, and customer experience solutions, including content production, loyalty programs, and intelligent product marketing, leveraging creativity, data, design, engineering, and AI to build adaptive growth systems for clients.

products.name: Cybersecurity Services
products.description: Comprehensive cybersecurity solutions including advisory, managed detection and response, digital risk management, cloud and data security, zero trust design, and incident response, integrating security controls and AI-driven tools into client systems and processes.

products.name: Industry-Specific Technology Solutions
products.description: Tailored technology consulting, engineering, and digital transformation services for specific industries such as financial services, consumer goods, retail, travel, software & hi-tech, business information & media, life sciences & healthcare, and emerging verticals, addressing unique regulatory, operational, and innovation needs.

products.name: Cystic Fibrosis (CF) Therapeutics
products.description: Oral small molecule medicines designed to normalize the function of the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) protein in people with cystic fibrosis. These therapeutics include proprietary NBD1 stabilizers and complementary CFTR modulators (correctors and potentiators), delivered as single agents or in proprietary dual combinations, and are developed through extensive biophysical, cell-based, and structural biology research. Products are manufactured by third parties and intended for commercial sale upon regulatory approval.

products.name: Senior Secured Lending
products.description: Provision of directly originated senior secured loans, including first-lien and unitranche loans, to private equity-owned U.S. middle market companies. These loans are typically structured and underwritten by the company and require significant financial capital, credit analysis, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Junior Capital Solutions
products.description: Provision of junior capital, including second-lien loans, subordinated debt (secured and unsecured), and mezzanine debt, to middle market companies. These products are structured to provide higher yields and may include equity participation or warrants, requiring specialized credit structuring and risk management.

products.name: Equity Co-Investments
products.description: Minority equity investments made alongside private equity sponsors in portfolio companies, typically as part of a broader debt financing package. These investments are opportunistic and require due diligence and partnership with sponsors.

products.name: Liquid Credit Investments
products.description: Investment in liquid fixed-income securities, including broadly syndicated loans and other liquid credit instruments, managed as part of the company's portfolio allocation. These are managed digitally and require active portfolio management and trading expertise.

products.name: Digital Colocation Services
products.description: Provision of data center space, power, and infrastructure for customers to colocate their specialized computers (such as digital asset miners) and related equipment. Delivered through physical facilities with tailored agreements, including both fee-based and profit-sharing models.

products.name: AI and HPC Colocation Services
products.description: Provision of data center infrastructure and power for customers to colocate AI and high-performance computing (HPC) hardware, such as GPUs, for computational and processing tasks. Delivered via physical data centers with both fee-based and profit-sharing agreements.

products.name: Energy Management Services
products.description: Participation in energy management and demand response programs, leveraging proprietary software and analysis to optimize energy usage and generate revenue by curtailing power consumption in response to grid needs. Delivered through software-driven operational adjustments and participation in power market programs.

products.name: Digital Asset Mining (Self-Mining)
products.description: Operation of proprietary digital asset mining hardware (primarily for Bitcoin) in company-owned data centers, earning digital assets as rewards and routinely liquidating them for fiat currency. Requires significant physical infrastructure, specialized mining equipment, and access to competitively priced power.

products.name: Equipment Sales (Miners, Transformers, Modular Data Centers)
products.description: Occasional sale of surplus or upgraded hardware, including digital asset miners, transformers, and modular data centers, to external customers. Sales are opportunistic and depend on inventory and upgrade cycles.

products.name: Botanical Drugs for Central Nervous System Disorders
products.description: Development and outlicensing of botanical drug candidates targeting central nervous system diseases such as Major Depressive Disorder, Adult ADHD, and Depression in Cancer Patients. These drugs are produced through pharmaceutical R&D, clinical trials, and GMP manufacturing, and are delivered as oral capsules for clinical and eventual commercial use.

products.name: Oncology and Hematology Therapeutics
products.description: Development and outlicensing of drug candidates for oncology and hematology indications, including Myelodysplastic Syndrome, Pancreatic Cancer, Triple Negative Breast Cancer, Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, and related cancers. These therapeutics are based on botanical extracts and are advanced through clinical trials for eventual commercialization.

products.name: Medical Device for Vitrectomy Surgery (Vitargus)
products.description: Development and outlicensing of Vitargus, a vitreous substitute medical device used in vitrectomy surgery for retinal detachment. The device is manufactured under GMP conditions and advanced through clinical trials for regulatory approval and commercialization.

products.name: Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) Services
products.description: Provision of GMP-certified manufacturing services for small quantities of drugs, including API production, encapsulation, granulation, tablet compression, coating, and packaging for clinical trials (Phase I-III) and regulatory submissions (ANDA, IND). Services are delivered to external clients in the pharmaceutical industry.

products.name: Maitake Mushroom-Based Dietary Supplements
products.description: Manufacture and sale of dietary supplements based on maitake mushroom extracts, available in tablet and liquid forms. These supplements are produced in a GMP facility and distributed to high-end grocery stores and through exclusive distribution agreements in Asia and North America.

products.name: Body Armor
products.description: Manufactures and sells a full range of advanced armor solutions, including concealable, corrections, and tactical armor, as well as ballistic plates and shields. Products are made-to-measure, incorporate innovative materials and processes, and comply with U.S. and international ballistic performance standards. Delivered through direct and indirect channels globally.

products.name: Explosive Ordnance Disposal Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and distributes operator survival suits, remotely operated vehicles, specialty tools, blast sensors, and vehicle blast attenuation seats for bomb safety technicians. Products integrate protective technologies with electronic components and communications equipment, serving military and law enforcement globally.

products.name: Duty Gear (Holsters, Belts, and Accessories)
products.description: Manufactures and sells holsters with industry-standard safety locking mechanisms, as well as complementary officer duty gear including belts and accessories. Products are engineered for durability and performance, and are sold under recognized brands to law enforcement, military, and commercial markets worldwide.

products.name: Nuclear Safety Equipment and Services
products.description: Provides highly engineered technical products and turnkey solutions for nuclear safety, including engineered equipment, vessels, precision components, process systems, large-scale fabrications, remote handling systems, ventilation and containment, radiometric instrumentation, and advanced containers. Also offers field services for nuclear power generation, waste management, research, and decommissioning.

products.name: Other Protective Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, assembles, and markets supplementary protective equipment such as chem light solutions, communications gear, forensic and investigation products, firearms cleaning solutions, and crowd control products. These products are marketed under niche brands and complement the core safety product portfolio.

products.name: Distribution of Third-Party First Responder Equipment
products.description: Operates as a one-stop shop for first responders by distributing third-party products such as uniforms, optics, boots, firearms, and ammunition, in addition to its own manufactured products, through owned and partner distribution channels.

products.name: Korean and Korean-American Casual Dining Restaurant Services
products.description: GEN Inc. operates company-owned casual dining restaurants offering an extensive menu of traditional Korean and Korean-American food, including high-quality meats, poultry, and seafood, served in a unique 'cook-it-yourself' format where guests grill food at their tables. The experience is delivered in physical restaurant locations with modern decor and embedded grills, requiring in-person dining and regulated food service operations.

products.name: Ready-to-Cook Korean Meal Kits for Grocery Retail
products.description: GEN Inc. sells ready-to-cook Korean meals through partnerships with grocery stores, distributing these meal kits to over 800 locations with plans for further expansion. These products are manufactured and packaged for retail sale, allowing customers to prepare GEN's signature dishes at home.

products.name: Wholesale Bulk Korean Meats
products.description: GEN Inc. offers wholesale bulk purchase options of high-quality Korean meats, initially introduced during the COVID-19 pandemic and selectively pursued with national food retailers. This involves supplying large quantities of meats for resale or bulk consumer purchase, leveraging their supplier network and distribution capabilities.

products.name: BRIUMVI (ublituximab-xiiy) Intravenous Infusion
products.description: An anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody biologic for the treatment of adults with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (RMS), administered via intravenous infusion every 24 weeks. Manufactured using biologic processes and delivered through healthcare providers in clinical settings.

products.name: BRIUMVI (ublituximab-xiiy) Subcutaneous Formulation (in development)
products.description: A subcutaneous formulation of ublituximab for the treatment of RMS, designed for administration under the skin, potentially allowing for self-administration or administration outside of infusion centers. Currently in Phase 3 clinical development.

products.name: Azer-cel (Azercabtagene Zapreleucel) for Progressive Multiple Sclerosis (in development)
products.description: An allogeneic (off-the-shelf) CD19-directed CAR T cell therapy under development for the treatment of progressive forms of multiple sclerosis. Manufactured from donor-derived T cells modified using genome editing technology and delivered as a cell therapy infusion.

products.name: Cryogenic Storage and Distribution Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and supplies bulk, microbulk, and mobile equipment for the storage, distribution, vaporization, and application of industrial gases and hydrocarbons, using vacuum insulation technology and engineered systems. Products include cryogenic storage tanks, trailers, ISO containers, and vaporization equipment.

products.name: Engineered Heat Transfer and Gas Processing Systems
products.description: Supplies mission critical engineered equipment and process systems for the separation, liquefaction, and purification of hydrocarbons and industrial gases, including brazed aluminum heat exchangers, cold boxes, pressure vessels, air cooled heat exchangers, and fans, primarily for natural gas, petrochemical, and LNG applications.

products.name: Specialty Gas and Liquid Handling Solutions
products.description: Provides highly-engineered equipment and process technologies for specialty end-market applications including hydrogen and helium, biofuels, carbon capture, food and beverage, metals and mining, aerospace, lasers, and water treatment. Includes hydrogen liquefaction, storage, transportation, fueling stations, compressors, and heat exchangers.

products.name: Repair, Service, and Equipment Leasing
products.description: Provides installation, retrofitting, refurbishment, spares, service, repair, maintenance, and digital monitoring for Chart and third-party equipment globally, as well as targeted equipment leasing solutions. Services cover the full lifecycle of proprietary and non-proprietary equipment.

products.name: Digital Monitoring and Industrial Software
products.description: Offers digital platforms and proprietary software for equipment performance monitoring, process optimization, and specialized industrial applications, including Uptime™ for equipment data integration and Ventsim™ DESIGN for mine and tunnel ventilation design and simulation.

products.name: Boltbody™ Immune-Stimulating Antibody Conjugate (ISAC) Therapies
products.description: A pipeline of immune-activating cancer therapies based on proprietary Boltbody ISAC technology, which combines tumor-targeting antibodies with immune-stimulating linker-payloads. These biologic drugs are manufactured using third-party CDMOs and delivered via infusion for the treatment of various solid tumors.

products.name: Claudin 18.2-targeting ISAC (BDC-4182)
products.description: A next-generation Boltbody ISAC drug candidate targeting the claudin 18.2 antigen for the treatment of gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer and potentially other tumor types. Manufactured using third-party CDMOs and delivered as a biologic therapy.

products.name: CEA-targeting ISAC
products.description: A Boltbody ISAC drug candidate targeting carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) for the treatment of various solid tumors, including colorectal, non-small cell lung, pancreatic, and breast cancers. Developed using proprietary antibody-linker-payload technology and manufactured externally.

products.name: PD-L1-targeting ISAC
products.description: A Boltbody ISAC drug candidate utilizing a novel anti-PD-L1 antibody conjugated to a TLR7/8 agonist payload for the treatment of cancers expressing PD-L1. Manufactured using third-party CDMOs and delivered as a biologic therapy.

products.name: Dectin-2 Agonist Antibody (BDC-3042)
products.description: A first-in-class agonist antibody therapy targeting dectin-2 to repolarize tumor-associated macrophages and elicit anti-tumor immune responses. Developed as a biologic drug and manufactured externally for clinical use.

products.name: Automotive Vehicles
products.description: Manufacture and sale of automobiles, including cars, trucks, and SUVs, produced in multiple regions and delivered through a global distribution network. Production requires large-scale physical manufacturing and a unionized workforce.

products.name: Automotive Financing Services
products.description: Provision of vehicle financing and leasing services to customers, primarily through a dedicated financial services subsidiary. This business line requires significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Home Health Services
products.description: Medicare-certified skilled home health services delivered in patients' homes, including nursing care, physical, occupational and speech therapy, medical social work, and home health aide services. Services are provided by clinicians and therapists following physician prescriptions, typically after acute illness, surgery, or chronic condition exacerbation.

products.name: Hospice Services
products.description: Medicare-certified skilled hospice services provided to terminally ill patients and their families, including nursing care, pain and symptom management, palliative and dietary counseling, social worker visits, spiritual counseling, and bereavement support. Services are delivered in the patient's home and focus on quality of life and symptom relief rather than curative treatment.

products.name: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) Systems
products.description: Integrated wearable medical devices that continuously measure glucose levels in interstitial fluid, wirelessly transmit data to receivers or mobile devices, and provide real-time alerts and trend information. These systems require physical manufacturing of sensors, transmitters, and receivers, and are regulated medical devices sold globally to patients, caregivers, and clinicians for diabetes and metabolic health management.

products.name: Over-the-Counter Glucose Biosensor
products.description: A wearable biosensor designed for adults with prediabetes and Type 2 diabetes who do not use insulin, sold directly to consumers without a prescription. Manufactured as a medical device, it provides continuous glucose data for metabolic health optimization and is distributed through retail and online channels.

products.name: Cloud-Based Diabetes Data Management Software
products.description: Digital software platforms, including Dexcom Clarity, that aggregate, analyze, and report glucose data from CGM systems, enabling patients and healthcare providers to review trends and manage diabetes care. Delivered as cloud-based applications, these platforms support remote monitoring and integration with other digital health tools.

products.name: Remote Glucose Monitoring and Sharing Applications
products.description: Mobile and cloud-based applications (Dexcom Share and Dexcom Follow) that allow real-time remote monitoring and sharing of glucose data with designated caregivers or family members. These digital services are delivered via mobile apps and cloud infrastructure, supporting care coordination and safety.

products.name: CGM Integration and Data/API Partnerships
products.description: Technology integration services and APIs that enable third-party insulin delivery systems, digital health apps, and devices to receive and utilize real-time CGM data. Delivered through software interfaces and commercial partnerships, these offerings expand the CGM ecosystem and support semi-automated insulin delivery and data analytics.

products.name: Electricity Transmission and Distribution Services
products.description: Regulated delivery of electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers via owned transmission and distribution networks in Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Virginia, and Rhode Island. Involves physical infrastructure, regulated tariffs, and in-person maintenance.

products.name: Electricity Generation and Wholesale Supply
products.description: Regulated generation of electricity from coal, natural gas, hydro, and solar power plants in Kentucky and Virginia, with sales to retail and wholesale customers. Requires physical power plants, fuel procurement, and compliance with environmental regulations.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Regulated distribution and sale of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Kentucky and Rhode Island, using owned pipeline and storage infrastructure. Involves physical delivery networks and regulated pricing.

products.name: Default Electricity Supply (Provider of Last Resort / Last Resort Service)
products.description: Procurement and sale of electricity supply to customers who do not choose a competitive supplier, under regulated default service plans in Pennsylvania and Rhode Island. Involves energy procurement contracts and regulatory compliance, but not physical generation in Pennsylvania or Rhode Island.

products.name: Solar Share Program
products.description: Subscription-based solar energy program allowing customers to purchase capacity in a jointly owned solar facility in Kentucky. Involves construction and operation of solar generation assets and customer subscription management.

firms.firm: CRACKER BARREL OLD COUNTRY STORE, INC

products.name: Full-Service Restaurant Dining (Cracker Barrel)
products.description: Home-style country cooking served in a full-service restaurant setting, offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner with dine-in, pick-up, and delivery options. Food is prepared in-store using proprietary recipes and served by staff in a sit-down environment.

products.name: Retail Gift Shop Merchandise (Cracker Barrel)
products.description: A curated selection of retail merchandise including apparel, accessories, toys, décor, media, food items, and seasonal gifts, sold in-store at Cracker Barrel locations. Products are sourced from various vendors and distributed through a central warehouse or direct shipment.

products.name: Off-Premise Food Services (Cracker Barrel)
products.description: Prepared meals and menu items offered for takeout, third-party delivery, and catering, including individual orders and multi-serving family meal baskets. Orders are fulfilled in-store and delivered via guests or third-party platforms.

products.name: Alcoholic Beverage Sales (Cracker Barrel)
products.description: Beer and wine sold as part of the restaurant dining experience at most Cracker Barrel locations, purchased and distributed through multiple distributors and served in-store.

products.name: Restaurant Dining (Maple Street Biscuit Company)
products.description: Fast casual breakfast and lunch restaurant service featuring made-from-scratch, biscuit-inspired entrées, proprietary blend coffee, and limited beer and wine, served in a smaller footprint with limited hours.

products.name: Warehouse Club Merchandise Sales
products.description: Sale of a broad selection of merchandise—including groceries, cleaning supplies, health and beauty aids, fresh foods (meat, produce, deli, seafood, poultry), electronics, appliances, automotive, hardware, sporting goods, seasonal products, clothing, home furnishings, and domestics—through membership-based warehouse clubs. Products are sourced globally and sold in large pack sizes at physical club locations.

products.name: Private Label Products (Member’s Selection®)
products.description: Sale of exclusive private label products under the Member’s Selection® brand, covering a range of consumable and non-consumable goods, available only at PriceSmart clubs. These products are sourced and developed to provide affordable alternatives to national brands.

products.name: Health Services (Optical, Audiology, Pharmacy)
products.description: Provision of in-club health services including optical (eye exams, eyeglasses), audiology (hearing tests, hearing aids), and pharmacy services. These services are delivered by in-store professionals at select warehouse club locations.

products.name: Food Service and Bakery
products.description: Operation of in-club food service and bakery departments, offering prepared foods and baked goods to members. These are produced on-site at warehouse clubs for immediate consumption or take-away.

products.name: Digital Shopping and Delivery Services (PriceSmart.com, Click & Go®)
products.description: Online shopping platform and mobile app enabling members to purchase merchandise for home delivery or curbside pickup. Orders are fulfilled from club inventory and delivered via in-house or third-party logistics.

products.name: Membership Program (Diamond, Business, Platinum)
products.description: Sale of annual memberships (Diamond, Business, Platinum) granting access to warehouse clubs, exclusive pricing, and additional benefits such as cashback rewards and co-branded credit card incentives. Memberships are sold directly to individuals and businesses.

products.name: Export Sales to Third-Party Retailers
products.description: Export of merchandise to third-party retailers in select international markets outside the core club footprint. Products are sourced and shipped to external retail partners as business opportunities arise.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate loans, construction loans, revolving lines of credit, and equipment financing. These are typically secured by business assets or real estate and require in-person underwriting and regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Originates and services residential mortgage loans for primary and secondary residences, including home equity loans and lines of credit. Loans are originated through branch and digital channels and may be held in portfolio or sold into the secondary market.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans such as auto loans, personal loans, unsecured overdraft lines of credit, and loans secured by savings accounts or certificates of deposit. These are delivered through branch and digital channels and require regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a broad range of deposit products including personal and commercial checking accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, retirement accounts, and safe deposit boxes. Delivered through branch, ATM, and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Digital and Remote Banking Services
products.description: Offers internet banking, mobile/digital banking, telephone banking, ACH origination, wire transfers, and remote deposit capture for both retail and business customers. These services are delivered digitally and require secure, regulated technology infrastructure.

products.name: Equipment Leasing and Financing
products.description: Provides commercial equipment leasing and financing services nationwide through a specialized division. Involves underwriting, asset management, and regulated financial operations.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Offers investment advisory, personalized investment management, 401(k) advisory for employers, financial planning, and trust services to individuals, families, businesses, and non-profits. Delivered through dedicated wealth management professionals and regulated fiduciary infrastructure.

products.name: Insurance Agency Services
products.description: Provides insurance products and services through a wholly owned insurance agency subsidiary, generating commission revenue via third-party insurance agreements. Delivered through licensed agents and regulated by state insurance authorities.

products.name: Sterilization and Disinfection Control Products and Services
products.description: Manufactures and sells biological, chemical, and cleaning indicators, as well as provides sterility assurance testing and laboratory services to assess the effectiveness of sterilization, decontamination, disinfection, and cleaning processes. Products are physically manufactured and delivered as consumables and hardware, with services performed in-person or in laboratories.

products.name: Clinical Genomics Systems, Consumables, and Services
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and sells genetic analysis instruments (MassARRAY system), proprietary consumables (chips, panels, reagents), and related services (maintenance, custom lab services) enabling high-throughput genomic testing for research labs and contract research organizations. Products are assembled from subcomponents and reagents, delivered as hardware and consumables, with services provided via contracts or laboratory work.

products.name: Biopharmaceutical Development Instruments, Consumables, and Services
products.description: Develops, manufactures, sells, and services automated systems for protein analysis (immunoassays) and peptide synthesis, including related consumables and software. Products are physically manufactured instruments and consumables, with services provided through maintenance agreements and support.

products.name: Calibration Solutions Products and Services
products.description: Develops, manufactures, sells, installs, and services quality control products for advanced metrology, including continuous monitoring systems, dialysate meters and consumables, data loggers, gas flow calibration and air sampling equipment, and torque testing systems. Products are assembled from components and calibrated, with services including installation, recalibration, and recertification performed on-site or in facilities.

products.name: Background Screening Services
products.description: Comprehensive pre-onboarding and post-onboarding background screening services for employees, contractors, and contingent workers, including criminal background checks, education and employment verification, drug and health screening, and executive screening. Delivered via proprietary technology platforms integrating multiple data sources and automated workflows.

products.name: Identity Verification and Fraud Mitigation Solutions
products.description: Digital identity verification and fraud mitigation tools, including biometric authentication, liveness detection, government ID validation, facial recognition, device verification, and synthetic identity/deepfake detection. Delivered through AI-powered, configurable digital platforms integrated with customer HR systems.

products.name: Continuous Risk and Compliance Monitoring
products.description: Ongoing post-onboarding monitoring solutions for criminal records, motor vehicle records, healthcare sanctions, global sanctions, licenses, and social media activity. Delivered via automated, real-time alerting and reporting systems integrated with customer workflows.

products.name: Driver and Fleet Compliance Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive compliance and risk management solutions for commercial drivers and fleet managers, including driver qualification file management, background checks, drug testing, motor vehicle record monitoring, and vehicle compliance (licenses, titles, registrations, fuel/gas tax). Delivered through specialized digital platforms and integrated data sources.

products.name: Healthcare Credentialing and Compliance Solutions
products.description: Verification and ongoing monitoring of healthcare employee credentials, exclusions, and sanctions, including education, licensure, and regulatory compliance for healthcare organizations. Delivered via proprietary databases and automated compliance monitoring tools.

products.name: Hiring Tax Credits and Incentives Processing
products.description: Identification and processing of U.S. federal, state, and local employment tax credits and economic incentive programs, leveraging applicant data collected during background screening to maximize credit eligibility and streamline compliance.

products.name: Investigative Research and Executive Due Diligence
products.description: In-depth investigative research and due diligence services for investment managers, senior executives, and major transactions, including civil litigation, bankruptcies, negative media, and regulatory history. Delivered through specialized research teams and proprietary data sources.

products.name: I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification
products.description: Digital solutions for managing and streamlining the I-9 employment eligibility verification process for new hires, integrated into customer onboarding workflows and compliant with regulatory requirements.

products.name: Oil Royalty Interests
products.description: The Trust receives income from net profits interests in oil production from underlying properties, which is generated by physical extraction and sale of crude oil by operators. The Trust does not operate wells but collects a share of proceeds from oil sales.

products.name: Natural Gas Royalty Interests
products.description: The Trust receives income from net profits interests in natural gas production from underlying properties, which is generated by physical extraction and sale of natural gas by operators. The Trust does not operate wells but collects a share of proceeds from gas sales.

products.name: Symphony Diagnostic Platform
products.description: A proprietary, compact, near-patient diagnostic platform consisting of an analyzer and single-use protein detection cartridges, designed to rapidly measure key blood biomarkers in critical care settings. The platform requires physical manufacturing of both hardware and consumable cartridges, and is intended for deployment in hospitals and similar environments.

products.name: Symphony IL-6 Test
products.description: A single-use immunoassay cartridge for the Symphony platform that measures interleukin-6 (IL-6) levels in whole blood to aid in monitoring disease progression and assessing mortality risk in sepsis and other critical care conditions. The test is manufactured as a disposable cartridge and is intended for use in conjunction with the Symphony analyzer.

products.name: Future Symphony Biomarker Tests
products.description: Additional single-use diagnostic test cartridges for the Symphony platform targeting other biomarkers, such as cardiac markers (hsTNT, NT pro-BNP) and potential tests for cardio-metabolic diseases, cancer, and other conditions requiring rapid diagnostics. These tests will be manufactured as disposable cartridges and used with the Symphony analyzer.

products.name: Symphony Platform for Research Use Only (RUO)
products.description: The Symphony analyzer and test cartridges offered for research use only (RUO) applications, enabling laboratories and research institutions to utilize the platform for non-clinical, investigational purposes prior to or outside of clinical regulatory clearance. This involves the same physical products but is marketed for research rather than patient care.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to businesses, including commercial and industrial loans, through in-person banking centers and specialized lending departments. Loans are typically secured by collateral such as real estate, inventory, or equipment.

products.name: Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans secured by real estate, including construction loans for single family residences and commercial buildings, equity loans, and lines of credit. Delivered through a dedicated Real Estate Division and mortgage broker services.

products.name: Agribusiness Lending
products.description: Provides loans to agricultural businesses, including land and production loans, through a specialized Agribusiness Center. Loans are typically secured by agricultural land or production assets.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers loans to individual consumers, including personal loans and auto loans, typically secured by collateral such as automobiles or other personal assets. Delivered through branch network and digital channels.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Accepts demand, savings, and time deposits from individual and commercial customers through full-service banking centers and digital channels. Deposits are FDIC insured up to applicable limits.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides cash management solutions for business customers, including account transfers, bill payment, and other treasury services, delivered via in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Internet and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Offers digital banking services such as account inquiry, status, bill payment, account transfers, and mobile banking applications, enabling customers to manage accounts remotely.

products.name: Wire Transfer Services
products.description: Provides domestic and international wire transfer services for customers, enabling electronic funds transfers through branch and digital channels.
